body:
Hey @mhevery .
thanks for taking care of this so fast, but i think it should be reopened.
i think the fix applied is not sufficient.
first, the preview text was not changed:
" gender property, which outputs one of the following string values: "m", "f" or "o" "
second, i think that the change is very confusing since the reader cant understand now where to put the values of the gender property and where to write the strings (since their text is the same...).
i think the fix should be: The author is {gender, select, male {m} female {f} other {o}}.
then it will be clear (using the preview text) that the gender property outputs the values m, f, o and where the user should put them in order to use it.

Yosi
